items.title: Pride and Prejudice
items.about: Emma Corrin and Jack Lowden spar as Elizabeth and Darcy, with Olivia Colman as Mrs. Bennet. Six episodes.

items.title: In a Holidaze
items.about: Maddie Ziegler gets stuck reliving the same family cabin Christmas, over and over. Rob Lowe costars.

items.title: Trinity
items.about: Gugu Mbatha Raw's naval officer digs up secrets that may tie Richard Madden's defense chief to a global threat.

items.title: The Hunchback, Soul of Paris
items.about: Vincent Cassel's Quasimodo is hunted for experiments in cholera stricken 1830s Paris. Victor Hugo, reimagined dark.

items.title: Love Is Blind, Habibi
items.about: Season 2 of the Arab dating experiment: new singles try to get engaged before ever seeing each other.

items.title: Al Qaid
items.about: Saud crosses the 1920s Arabian desert hunting Rimah and his men. Saudi epic with Yaqoub Al Farhan, coming soon.

items.title: Anbar El Mot
items.about: Menna Shalaby plays a nurse on death row over patient deaths, inspired by a real 1990s Alexandria case.

items.title: El Kalam Ala Eh?! Awel Leila
items.about: Four couples, one wedding night, endless chaos. Ahmed Hatem and Aya Samaha lead a stacked comic cast.

items.title: Fi El Zel 2
items.about: Revenge put him in prison among gangsters. Now the woman he loves has married someone close to him.

items.title: Hob Masmoum
items.about: Nour El Nabawy and Fatin Saeed play lovers whose romance turns toxic, then deadly. Next story in El Qessa El Kamla.

items.title: Alam Eftradi
items.about: Parents versus Gen Z: how online life rewires young love and choices. Fathy Abdel Wahab and Jamika star. Coming soon.

items.title: El Gawahergy
items.about: Mohamed Henedy and Mona Zaki are a bickering couple whose marriage counselling only makes things worse.

items.title: Khally Balak Men Nafsak
items.about: Ahmed El Sakka plays a commitment shy radio host who falls for Yasmine Abdel Aziz, an arms dealer.

items.title: Khamseen Khamseen (50/50)
items.about: Kinda Alloush leads a gang through one chaotic adventure after another, now streaming in full.

items.title: Sakret El Hob
items.about: War scarred lives in Syria and Lebanon collide in love. New episodes Sunday to Wednesday.

items.title: Dawlet El Telawa (Season 2)
items.about: 32 reciters from across Egypt compete. New episodes every Friday and Saturday night until Ramadan.

items.title: Dafneenah Sawa
items.about: Two ex thieves take security jobs at the compound built over the treasure they buried. Ten episodes.

items.title: Walad El Lazina
items.about: A young man's life spirals after he falls for the wrong girl.
